statement: The project lead needs repeatable measured hop data from a reduced-gravity analogue to compare locomotion concepts.
rationale: Mission need for Phase 1 concept selection
acceptance_criteria: Project lead confirms data set supports comparison

statement: The mission architect needs relocation hops that cannot lose the robot from the target body.
rationale: Loss of vehicle ends the mission
acceptance_criteria: Architect confirms launch speeds are well below escape

statement: The safety authority needs ground trials to run without exposing people to stored mechanical energy.
The locomotion system shall hop at a safe speed well below escape velocity and shall be robust to regolith variation.
acceptance_criteria: Analysis shows the hop speed is acceptable

statement: The locomotion system shall relocate the robot by at least 10 m per hop.
The robot shall settle quickly after landing.
acceptance_criteria: Settle time is short enough for operations

statement: The ground demonstrator shall record commanded actuation time and body acceleration at a sampling rate of 200 Hz (TBR) or more.
acceptance_criteria: Logged sample interval <= 5.0 ms for 3 consecutive trials
notes: Marked approved in the kick-off meeting

statement: The test rig shall remove actuator power within 0.5 s of emergency-stop activation.

statement: The ground demonstrator shall dump stored actuator energy where practical before operators approach.
The hop controller software shall inhibit actuator release when the estimated launch speed exceeds the limit.
